content:
The fastest animal on Earth in terms of maximum speed is the peregrine falcon. When in a hunting dive, known as a stoop, a peregrine falcon can reach speeds of over 240 miles per hour (386 kilometers per hour). This makes it the fastest bird and, in fact, the fastest member of the animal kingdom when measured by speed during flight.

On land, the fastest animal is the cheetah, which can run up to speeds of about 60 to 70 miles per hour (97 to 113 kilometers per hour) in short bursts covering distances up to 1,500 feet (460 meters), and has the ability to accelerate from 0 to 60 miles per hour in just a few seconds.
